name: paradoxcode-vscode
description: Independent, unofficial EU4 language tooling backed by pdx-ls, with a live mission-tree preview.

commands.title: Open Mission Tree Preview to the Side

paradoxcode.pdxLsPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `pdx-ls` server binary. When empty, the extension looks for `pdx-ls` on `PATH`.

paradoxcode.projectConfig.markdownDescription: Path to a `.pdx/project.toml` whose fields are overridden by the inline options below. When empty, a `.pdx/project.toml` next to the workspace root is discovered automatically, so VS Code and Zed share the same project configuration with no per-editor setup.

paradoxcode.modDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory of the current Mod being edited. Defaults to the workspace root. Mirrors `lsp.pdx-ls.initialization_options.modDirectory`.

paradoxcode.vanillaIndexCache.markdownDescription: Path to a persistent Vanilla index cache (`.pdxindex`). When absent, `pdx-ls` attempts automatic discovery once. Mirrors `lsp.pdx-ls.initialization_options.vanillaIndexCache`.

paradoxcode.dependencies.markdownDescription: Dependency Mods in order from lowest to highest priority. Items are `{ id, path, index? }`. Mirrors `lsp.pdx-ls.initialization_options.dependencies`.

paradoxcode.gameDirectory.markdownDescription: EU4 installation root (the folder containing `eu4.exe`). Backs the mission-tree preview with real game textures (`interface/*.gfx` + `gfx/interface/missions`). When empty, the server attempts one-time automatic discovery. Mirrors `lsp.pdx-ls.initialization_options.gameDirectory`.
